# 01. Vision & Objectives

## Project Purpose
High-performance headless portfolio designed to showcase software engineering expertise, full-stack capability (Laravel, Vue, Astro, WordPress), and technical writing.

## Primary Audience
Tech Leads, Senior Developers, and IT Recruiters looking for a backend/full-stack engineer.

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* **Performance:** 95+ score on Google Lighthouse (Performance, Accessibility, SEO, Best Practices).
* **Load Time:** Sub-second LCP (Largest Contentful Paint).
* **User Experience:** Clean navigation, clear project breakdown, dark-mode/tech aesthetic.
